description: The deep profile runs two passes over the same diff — a correctness pass and a security pass — and correlates their findings into one synthesis. Both answers are readable, each finding lands on a line the patch proves, and the run posts one comment carrying both: the same finding found by both passes would be reported once (corroborated), and a disagreement would be annotated, but here the two passes found different things and both are reported.

findings.body: Reads an absolute path from the process.
